title: T1585.003 — Establish Accounts - Cloud Accounts
subtitle: Watch a fresh cloud account become a phishing and C2 platform, then get taken down.
aria: Animation of an attacker registering a cloud account, deploying hosting and a server, pointing a fresh domain at it, hosting a phishing page, victims interacting, and the provider taking the resources down.

steps.caption: The attacker buys a prepaid card or steals card data, and prepares a disposable contact address
steps.defender: IdP and SaaS audit logs record token issuance, consent, sign-in location and API access.
